userStories.title: Activate gate-internal rectification
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Remove the `inlineReviewEnabled` gate from the rectification slot in `assemblePlanInputsFromCtx`, activating US-006a's gate rectification in production.

**Motivation** — US-006a's gate rectification code shipped in commit `35486416` but is unreachable in production because `plan-inputs.ts:258-265` gates `inputs.rectification` on `inlineReviewEnabled`, which defaults to `false`.

**Approach** — Drop the `inlineReviewEnabled` guard on the `rectificationInput` block only. Keep the guard on `semanticReviewInput` / `adversarialReviewInput` blocks — those are removed in US-005a. Simultaneously simplify `gatherRectificationFindings` to remove its `semanticPhase` and `adversarialPhase` parameters, since review findings will not feed rectification until US-005a wires the builder's review phases.

**Scope**
In:
- `src/execution/plan-inputs.ts` — remove `inlineReviewEnabled` condition from `rectificationInput` block (lines 258-265)
- `src/execution/story-orchestrator.ts` — simplify `gatherRectificationFindings` signature: remove `semanticPhase?` and `adversarialPhase?` params, remove the body logic that reads them; function now gathers only from `verifierPhase` and `fullSuiteGatePhase`

Out:
- `semanticReviewInput` / `adversarialReviewInput` gating — unchanged until US-005a
- No new files created
- No changes to `build-plan-for-strategy.ts`

**Interface** — Post-change `gatherRectificationFindings` signature:
```typescript
// src/execution/story-orchestrator.ts
function gatherRectificationFindings(
  phaseOutputs: Record<string, unknown>,
  verifierPhase: string | null,
  fullSuiteGatePhase?: string | null,
): Finding[]
// Removed params: semanticPhase?, adversarialPhase?
// Returns only findings with source "test-runner"
```

**Files touched:**
- `src/execution/plan-inputs.ts` (modify — remove rectification gate)
- `src/execution/story-orchestrator.ts` (modify — simplify gatherRectificationFindings)
acceptanceCriteria: `grep -n "inlineReviewEnabled" src/execution/plan-inputs.ts` shows no occurrences inside the `rectificationInput` block (occurrences inside `semanticReviewInput` / `adversarialReviewInput` blocks remain, removed by US-005a)

`assemblePlanInputsFromCtx` returns `rectification: { maxAttempts, strategies: [], abortOnIncreasingFailures }` (non-undefined) whenever `config.execution.rectification.enabled === true`, regardless of the value of `config.execution.inlineReview`

Given a TDD strategy config with `rectification.enabled: true` and `inlineReview: false`, when the full-suite gate phase produces `failed-test` findings, then `runFixCycle` inside the builder dispatches `makeFullSuiteRectifyStrategy` and `implementerOp` is invoked at least once
`grep -nE "semanticPhase|adversarialPhase" src/execution/story-orchestrator.ts` shows the `gatherRectificationFindings` function signature no longer accepts those parameters

`gatherRectificationFindings(phaseOutputs, verifierPhase, fullSuiteGatePhase)` returns only findings with `source === "test-runner"`; the function no longer reads a `semanticPhase` or `adversarialPhase` argument
suggestedCriteria: When `config.execution.rectification` is not configured (key absent), `assemblePlanInputsFromCtx` returns `rectification: undefined`
The `gatherRectificationFindings` callers inside `story-orchestrator.ts` (runRectification) compile without TypeScript errors after the parameter removal

userStories.title: Gating-preservation verification
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Write integration test fixtures that verify every config-driven gate behaves identically under the unified builder path (US-005a) as under the legacy pipeline stages, providing the safety net for US-005c's destructive cleanup.

**Motivation** — US-005c cannot safely delete legacy stages until dual-path behavioral equivalence is verified; US-005b provides that gate.

**Approach** — This story adds integration tests only — no new production code. Tests run against the current codebase where both unified path (US-005a) and legacy stages coexist, asserting equivalence across all config-driven gate scenarios.

**Test fixture design** — Each AC corresponds to one or more integration test scenarios in `test/integration/pipeline/`. Tests construct `PlanInputs` directly or run end-to-end via the pipeline with specific config, then assert on `phaseOutputs` keys and `runFixCycle` dispatch behavior.

**Per-check gating scenarios:**
- `review.enabled: true`, `review.checks: ["lint"]` only → `phaseOutputs` contains `"lint-check"` but not `"typecheck-check"`, `"semantic-review"`, `"adversarial-review"`
- `review.enabled: false` → none of the review/check phase outputs are present
- `review.checks` includes `"lint"` but `quality.commands.lint` is undefined → `phaseOutputs["lint-check"]` absent (command-missing skip)

**Per-strategy gating scenarios:**
- `quality.autofix.enabled: false` → rectification phase strategies contain no autofix strategies; `implementerRectifyOp` / `testWriterRectifyOp` never dispatched
- `quality.commands.lintFix` and `lintFixScoped` both undefined → no `makeMechanicalLintFixStrategy` in strategies; same for formatFix

**Belt-and-braces AC-005b.6** — When `lintFix` / `formatFix` commands are both undefined, the mechanical strategy's `fixOp.execute` returns early without invoking `runQualityCommand`. This defends against the strategy being constructed with a no-op command but still entering the cycle.

**Full-path regression** — Existing E2E test scenarios in `test/integration/pipeline/` covering: TDD success path, TDD failure-then-fix path, non-TDD path, review-finding rectification, mechanical-only failure suppression, partial-progress retry — all must pass against the unified path.

**Scope**
In:
- `test/integration/pipeline/` — new gating-preservation test fixtures

Out:
- No production code changes
- No new operation or strategy files
acceptanceCriteria: A config with `review.enabled: true` and `review.checks: ["lint"]` (no `"typecheck"`, `"semantic"`, `"adversarial"`) produces a plan whose `phaseOutputs` contains `"lint-check"` but does not contain `"typecheck-check"`, `"semantic-review"`, or `"adversarial-review"`
A config with `review.enabled: false` produces a plan whose `phaseOutputs` contains none of `"lint-check"`, `"typecheck-check"`, `"semantic-review"`, `"adversarial-review"`
A config with `review.checks` including `"lint"` but `config.quality.commands.lint` undefined produces a plan where `phaseOutputs["lint-check"]` is absent; same applies for typecheck

A config with `quality.autofix.enabled: false` produces a rectification phase whose strategies contain no `makeAutofixImplementerStrategy` / `makeAutofixTestWriterStrategy` entries — `implementerRectifyOp` and `testWriterRectifyOp` are never dispatched during the cycle

A config with `quality.commands.lintFix` and `lintFixScoped` both undefined produces a rectification phase whose strategies contain no `makeMechanicalLintFixStrategy` entry; same applies for `formatFix` / `formatFixScoped`

When `quality.commands.lintFix` and `lintFixScoped` are both `undefined`, `makeMechanicalLintFixStrategy().fixOp.execute({...})` returns `{ applied: true, exitCode: 0 }` without invoking `runQualityCommand`; same for `makeMechanicalFormatFixStrategy()` with `formatFix` undefined

Existing integration test scenarios in `test/integration/pipeline/` covering TDD success path, TDD failure-then-fix path, non-TDD path, review-finding rectification, mechanical-only failure suppression, and partial-progress retry all pass against the unified path
suggestedCriteria: A config with `review.checks: ["lint", "typecheck"]` produces a plan whose `phaseOutputs` contains both `"lint-check"` and `"typecheck-check"`
A non-TDD strategy config produces a plan whose `phaseOutputs` contains `"verify-scoped"` but not `"verifier"` or `"full-suite-gate"`
A TDD strategy config produces a plan whose `phaseOutputs` contains `"verifier"` and `"full-suite-gate"` but not `"verify-scoped"`

analysis:
## Architecture Context

Per-story execution runs through three overlapping sequencing abstractions today: pipeline stages (`src/pipeline/stages/`), builder phases (`StoryOrchestratorBuilder.CANONICAL_ORDER`), and fix strategies (`FixStrategy[]` inside `runFixCycle`). This migration collapses them to two: builder phases for ordering, FixStrategies for finding-driven fixes.

## Key Gating Mechanism

`inlineReviewEnabled = ctx.config.execution?.inlineReview === true` at `plan-inputs.ts:218` gates ALL review and rectification slot population in `assemblePlanInputsFromCtx`. With the default `false`, the builder's review and rectification phases are dormant, and review/rectification run as separate pipeline stages (`reviewStage`, `autofixStage`, `rectifyStage`). This is the root cause of the three problems the spec resolves.

## Current defaultPipeline (13 stages)

`queueCheckStage → routingStage → constitutionStage → contextStage → promptStage → optimizerStage → executionStage → verifyStage → rectifyStage → reviewStage → autofixStage → regressionStage → completionStage`

Target (9 stages): `queueCheckStage → routingStage → constitutionStage → contextStage → promptStage → optimizerStage → executionStage → regressionStage → completionStage`

## Key Files

- **`src/execution/plan-inputs.ts`**: `assemblePlanInputsFromCtx` has `inlineReviewEnabled` gate at line 218. Rectification slot populated only when `inlineReviewEnabled && rectification.enabled`. US-001 removes gate from rectification block only; US-005a removes gate from semantic/adversarial blocks.
- **`src/execution/story-orchestrator.ts`**: `CANONICAL_ORDER` at lines 86-94 (7 phases: test-writer, greenfield-gate, implementer, full-suite-gate, verifier, semantic-review, adversarial-review). `gatherRectificationFindings` at lines 190-209 currently takes `semanticPhase`/`adversarialPhase` params. `StoryOrchestratorResult` at lines 51-57 lacks `rectificationExhausted`/`unfixedFindings`. Builder has `addSemanticReview`/`addAdversarialReview` methods (deleted in US-005c).
- **`src/execution/build-plan-for-strategy.ts`**: Currently adds review phases via `hasReviewCheck(config, ...)` but these only fire when `inlineReviewEnabled` (since slot population is blocked upstream). US-005a wires the new check phases and strategies here.
- **`src/execution/post-run.ts`**: `applyPostRunInspection` reads `planResult.phaseOutputs` and populates ctx fields. Needs `mechanicalFailedOnly` rule extension and new `rectificationExhausted` branch in US-005a; needs three new ctx field derivations (verifyPassed, semanticReviewResult, rectificationIterationCount) for D3 migration.
- **`src/pipeline/stages/index.ts`**: defaultPipeline exports 13 stages including verify, rectify, review, autofix (4 deleted in US-005c), keeping regression.
- **`src/verification/rectification-loop.ts`** + **`src/verification/shared-rectification-loop.ts`**: Legacy framework deleted in US-002.
- **`src/findings/cycle.ts`**: `runFixCycle` and `FixStrategy<F,I,O,C>` interface — the SSOT for fix dispatch.
- **`src/quality/runner.ts`**: `runQualityCommand` used by all new check ops and mechanical fix strategies.
- **`src/findings/adapters/test-failure.ts`**: `testSummaryToFindings` adapter — converts test runner output to `Finding[]`; used in US-002 when converting rectify.ts and run-regression.ts call sites.

## DeterministicOperation Pattern (reference: `src/operations/full-suite-gate.ts`)

`kind: "deterministic"`, `stage`, `config` (config selector), `execute(input, ctx, deps)`. No LLM session, no `build`/`parse`/`retry`. Shell command execution + output parsing to `Finding[]`. Returns structured output with `success: boolean, findings: Finding[]`.

## FixStrategy Pattern (reference: `src/operations/full-suite-rectify.ts`, `src/pipeline/stages/autofix-cycle.ts:100-178`)

`name`, `appliesTo(finding) => boolean`, `fixOp: Operation<I,O,C>`, `buildInput(findings, prior, cycleCtx) => I`, `extractApplied(output, input) => FixApplied`, `maxAttempts`, `coRun: "exclusive" | "co-run-sequential"`.

Novel in US-004: mechanical strategies use a `DeterministicOperation` as `fixOp` (not a `RunOperation`). This is the first such usage in the codebase.

## Behavior Preservation — Key Rules

- **mechanicalFailedOnly rule** (`autofix.ts:186-199`): When only lint/typecheck findings remain unfixed after agent rectification (LLM review passed), return `{ action: "continue" }` instead of escalating. Ported to `applyPostRunInspection` in US-005a.
- **Mechanical-then-recheck-bail semantics**: Mechanical strategies run first; `runFixCycle` re-validates after each iteration. If mechanical fix resolves all findings, agent strategies find empty `appliesTo` and cycle exits with `no-findings-applicable`. Preserved implicitly by framework design.
- **Verifier-as-SSOT** (already in production): If verifier passes, gate failure is pre-existing regression; gate exempted from success aggregation. Preserved in unified path.

## autofix-implementer appliesTo predicate (spec-authoritative)

The spec AC-004.3 defines the NEW factory's predicate as: `fixTarget === "source" AND source ∈ {"lint", "typecheck", "semantic-review"}`. This is different from the OLD `autofix-cycle.ts` code (`(f.fixTarget ?? "source") === "source" && f.category !== "prd_quote_mismatch"`). The spec AC is authoritative — the new factory adds a `source` restriction and drops the null-coalescing and category guard. Implementers must follow the spec AC, not the old code.

## Pipeline Context Field Migration (D3)

Live consumers of stage-populated ctx fields outside stages being deleted:
- `completion.ts:122` reads `ctx.reviewResult.checks` → new source: `planResult.phaseOutputs["semantic-review"]`
- `regression.ts:30` reads `ctx.verifyResult.success` → new source: unified `ctx.verifyPassed` boolean derived in `applyPostRunInspection`
- `metrics/tracker.ts:107-110` reads `ctx.autofixAttempt` → new source: `planResult.phaseOutputs["rectification"]` iteration count
- `metrics/tracker.ts:175-176` reads `ctx.verifyResult.scopeTestFallback` → `planResult.phaseOutputs["verify-scoped"].scopeTestFallback`
- `tier-escalation.ts:267,287` reads `ctx.verifyResult` → refactored to take unified `verifyPassed` + `verifyStatus`

US-005a adds `ctx.verifyPassed`, `ctx.semanticReviewResult`, `ctx.rectificationIterationCount`; US-005c deletes the legacy fields.

## Migration Risks

1. **US-001**: Activates gate rectification in production for the first time (US-006a code shipped in commit 35486416 but never activated). Could expose bugs in `runRectification`. Coverage by integration test AC-001.3.
2. **US-002**: Converts two call sites from `runRectificationLoop` to `runFixCycle` — semantic differences in session-keeping, tier escalation, and debate diagnosis must be covered by integration tests (AC-002.5, AC-002.6a, AC-002.6b).
3. **US-005c**: Deletes stages serving real production traffic today. US-005b provides the safety net; US-005c is blocked on US-005b ACs being green.
4. **`addSemanticReview`/`addAdversarialReview` deletion**: Any external plugin calling these builder methods will break. No internal consumers audited per spec.
